name: Tissue-type segmentation with hsvs
summary: Generates a five-tissue-type (5TT) image from FreeSurfer output with MRtrix3 5ttgen hsvs (hybrid surface and volume segmentation), plus binarized gray matter, white matter and CSF masks, for anatomically-constrained tractography.
description: Runs 5ttgen hsvs on the FreeSurfer subject directory, optionally using a T1w image as the template that defines the output voxel grid, with options for hippocampus and thalamus segmentation methods, brainstem as white matter, cropping and amygdala/hippocampus as subcortical GM. Writes the 5TT image and binarized cortical GM, WM and CSF masks. Requires a FreeSurfer run; use the fsl-based App when only a T1 image is available.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer recon-all output directory used by 5ttgen hsvs.
Optional T1-weighted image passed as -template to 5ttgen hsvs so the 5TT image is written on its voxel grid.

outputs.description: 5TT image (mask.nii.gz) plus binarized gray matter (gm.nii.gz), white matter (wm.nii.gz) and CSF (csf.nii.gz) masks extracted from its volumes.

parameters.description: Hippocampus segmentation method for 5ttgen hsvs -hippocampi: subfields, first or aseg.
Thalamus segmentation method for 5ttgen hsvs -thalami: nuclei, first or aseg.
classify the brainstem as white matter (true)
do not crop resulting 5tt image to reduce size
represent the amygdalae and hippocampi as sub-cortical grey matter in the 5tt image

citations.text: Smith RE, Tournier J-D, Calamante F, Connelly A. Anatomically-constrained tractography: Improved diffusion MRI streamlines tractography through effective use of anatomical information. NeuroImage 62:1924-1938 (2012).

failure_modes.cause: The CSF mask was not produced, so 5ttgen hsvs or mrconvert failed.
failure_modes.fix: Check the log for the 5ttgen hsvs error, e.g. missing FreeSurfer files needed by the chosen hippocampal/thalami method.
